headword: {処理能力|しょりのうりょく}

definitions.explanation: The ability or capacity to handle and process tasks, data, or work. Used for both technological systems (computers, servers) and human or organizational capability.

examples.japanese: ⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{処理能力|しょりのうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The computer's processing power is high.

examples.japanese: {処理能力|しょりのうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: An amount of work beyond our processing capacity came in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦サーバー→サーバー：04755_saabaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えて→変える：01089_kaeru⟧{処理能力|しょりのうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}した→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧。
examples.english: Processing capacity improved significantly after switching to a new server.

notes:
{処理能力|しょりのうりょく} combines ⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ (processing) and ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ (ability/capacity).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {処理能力|しょりのうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ — high/low processing power
- {処理能力|しょりのうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ — to increase processing power
- {処理能力|しょりのうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ — insufficient processing capacity
- {処理能力|しょりのうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧ — to exceed processing capacity

While most commonly used in technology contexts, it also applies to organizational capacity (e.g., a factory's output capacity or a government office's ability to handle applications).
